annotations.title: Book a customer into an event

description: Register a customer for a class or appointment, optionally using a specific customer membership, or comped (free). Returns the attendance id. Undo with goteamup_unregister_customer_from_event. TeamUp: POST /events/{id}/register.

comped.description: Book as comped (no membership use / charge). Default false.

customer_membership.description: The customer membership id to book with (omit to let TeamUp choose).

name: goteamup_register_customer_for_event
title: Book a customer into an event
